context: The detection report lists two consent-platform matches (Didomi and one other), two heuristic modals, and scroll_locked: true with a CSS scroll_fix. Sessions are disposable, so hiding is preferred over clicking through consent. Judge cleanup.sh.

checklist.name: hides_all_overlays
checklist.description: cleanup.sh applies the `hide` CSS rules for all four overlays in the report (#didomi-host/#didomi-notice, #cmp-container-id/.main--cmp, #didomi-popup, #dialog-menu).

checklist.name: scroll_fix
checklist.description: Because scroll_locked is true, cleanup.sh also applies the report's scroll_fix (html,body overflow:auto).

checklist.name: single_injection
checklist.description: The rules are applied in one playwright-cli eval call (e.g. one injected <style> element), not one command per overlay.

checklist.name: no_consent_clicks
checklist.description: Does not click through the consent platforms' dismiss steps, since the session is thrown away and clicking is slower.

checklist.name: valid_eval_expression
checklist.description: Each playwright-cli eval argument is a single JavaScript expression (no top-level statements separated by semicolons, no bare `return`).

checklist.name: residual_check
checklist.description: Includes a check for remaining viewport-covering elements, e.g. an eval that lists position:fixed elements with a high z-index that intersect the viewport, or a viewport screenshot to inspect.

checklist.name: page_not_broken
checklist.description: Does not hide or remove <html> or <body>.
